title: How to survive a zombie apocalypse
idea: Survive it (realistic): five friends in a fifth-floor flat over a street full of zombies that hunt by sound; hunger sends them over a ladder to the shop roof, and one greedy bag of tins nearly kills them
format: series: Survive it (title spoken at 0.0, day HUD, one cause-and-effect chain, realistic, stands alone)

visible.why: P01: the door fight: hands in the gap, the arm on the Samurai, Spud and the wardrobe
the alarm outside: the hands let go, the wardrobe shuts the door
P02: from the balcony: the whole street flows to the flashing car
P03: the tap is dry; the last water is in the toilet cistern
P04: a bucket behind a screen on the balcony; nobody meets anybody's eyes
P05: one tin for five, one spoon; the Wizard too weak to sit up; the barricaded door behind
P06: Phoenix's stomach growls; everyone stares at him
the pane fills with silhouettes and the door bulges: staying is over
P07: a ladder from the balcony to the shop roof, hundreds of zombies under it, none looking up
P08: the Gunslinger stuffs a bag far too heavy; Spud, with one tin, signals enough
P09: the bag bends the ladder; one tin slips out and falls
P10: the tin hits the car, the alarm; hundreds of faces turn straight up
P11: the ladder hangs in a V; he dangles by one hand, the bag in the other, until he lets it go
the flat door bursts: no way back
all five scramble over the cracked ladder; the zombies reach the balcony; the ladder falls
P12: all five alive on the roof with one tin; a stomach growls and the old balcony turns to look
